frago.mission: Gather every narrative invariant and pushback into one register and wire it through every system, **in order to** make every scene, character and place answerable to the same few rules.
frago.order: **Rule the calls below** (one word: "all recs"; 81-J is yours alone). Then the register builds first, about 1 hour.
frago.default: Silence: nothing builds; BOLO 77 stays gated.

calls.q: 81-A · What do we call a rule the story can never break?
calls.options: Tenet · Law · General Order · Standing Order · keep "invariant"
calls.default: Tenet (rec): "Law" collides with the Administration's in-world Ecclesial Laws

calls.q: 81-B · Bring the three pushbacks into canon?
calls.options: yes, as drafts, with their own rule that no one character speaks all three · leave them in the old notes
list each in one line (already done in NNI-INDEX.md) · rewrite each as a canon entry · leave them
calls.default: the one-line list stands (rec); rewrite none

calls.q: 81-D · Put an invariants field on the plot system?
calls.options: yes: the plot card and every fabula event name the rule they test · no
calls.default: yes (rec): today only the scene cards carry it, three different ways

calls.options: yes: flags a scene that tests no rule, or breaks one without a pushback · no
yes: four files still say DOCTRINE 0 awaits ratification (it was ratified 9/3) · no
one register doc, ssot_01_invariants_register.md · spread across the systems as now
add truth_is_exploit · merit_to_control · optionlock_not_timelock to her character sheet (ratified in the ingest, never filed) · leave

calls.q: 81-I · Trash Land's two candidate rules (matter vs. people)
calls.options: merge into one, the ruled-KEEP one leads · keep both

calls.q: 81-J · The Ecclesial Laws: whose are they?
calls.options: the school's only (as wired now) · the whole world's (the Administration governs everywhere)
calls.default: your call: canon doesn't say; wired as the school's until you rule

calls.q: 81-K · Six Movements: two sources label the six slots differently
calls.options: the dedicated Six Movements doc wins · the other source wins

groups.label: What already existed, before this pass looked

items.t: DOCTRINE 0 — the Seven meta-rules — RATIFIED 2026-09-03 (Chief: "doctrine zero is good"); the rename of the word "invariant" itself (Tenet / Ethos bench) stayed open.

The constraint layer wired into four live mechanisms on 2026-08-25: the Scale Ladder's completion tests, the Collision Engine's L12×S12 row, the character system's `narrative_invariant` field, and the Setting System's S12 cells.
Three place-scoped S12 invariants (DCUS · Trash Land · ASTRO7EX) RULED KEEP 2026-09-15; `cost_and_meaning` LOCKED on the OXO storyform as Tori's story-level invariant.
Row 9's scene card checks six sources against its invariants — the one instance where the field is fully used.

Three pushbacks — Effectiveness Without Fairness · The Mirror of Participation · Interior Ownership of Choice — named once, on this BOLO's own boresight row, and otherwise live only in the un-migrated Joplin import.
A ~48-work NNI inspiration shelf (film, TV, anime, games, each carrying four "non-negotiable invariants") sat in the Joplin import, never migrated into canon.

No field for invariants anywhere in the plot system (fabula, trope graph, syuzhet), no theme document at all, and no script anywhere that checks a card, character, or place against its declared invariants.

The NNI shelf's real count, script-extracted: 47 works with a Defined-Invariants section, 188 invariants total, six methodology/systems files with none — correcting the old PS header's 49×4=196 (`NNI-INDEX.md` §8, Summary Counts).
Four stale records still say DOCTRINE 0 "awaits ratification" though it was ratified 2026-09-03 and never corrected: the spine tree, the modern-poetics doc, and STATE.md twice (DISTILL.md §6).

The story-level schema is thinner than its own source — the L12 field holds one invariant (`cost_and_meaning`) where its cited derivation defines four; three (`truth_is_exploit`, `merit_to_control`, `optionlock_not_timelock`) are locked per source but have no schema home (DISTILL.md §6).

Five contradictions found and named (DISTILL.md §7): the two Six-Movement sources disagree on four of six movement labels; the schema-vs-source gap on Tori's invariants; "Ecclesial Laws" claimed both place-scoped and IP-wide in different documents; two unmerged Trash Land S12 candidates; the rename ruling's own status stated three different ways across documents.

paragraphs.plain: A mission is a task plus the reason for it. This one's reason: the rules the story can never break exist in pieces across a dozen files and the old notes, and nothing checks a scene against them.
